'''August 2001 Buford tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in GQ, Buford, Georgia on 4 August 2001. [[Alex Heerman]] won it. It is known from Zafar Tejani's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2814">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-09-z-goes-to-gq-buford-aug-4th-2001d2814/ z-goes-to-gq-buford-aug-4th-2001], DeckTech (Zafar "Zmanthe1st" Tejani, 9 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-09-z-goes-to-gq-buford-aug-4th-2001d2814/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 4 August 2001
* '''Site:''' GQ, Buford, Georgia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 16
* '''Winner:''' [[Alex Heerman]]
